preconditions.description: The number of pieces n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= 10**9 for p in strengths)
preconditions.description: Each piece strength is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(strengths) == n and len(assignment) == n and all(c in 'AB' for c in assignment)
preconditions.description: The strengths list and assignment string both have length n, and the assignment string contains only 'A' or 'B'.

postconditions.expression: output_value == max(bob_strength_no_flip, max(bob_strength_prefix_flip(k) for k in range(1, n + 1)), max(bob_strength_suffix_flip(k) for k in range(1, n + 1)))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum strength Bob can achieve by either doing nothing, flipping a prefix of length k (1 <= k <= n), or flipping a suffix of length k (1 <= k <= n).

postconditions.expression: bob_strength_no_flip == sum(strengths[i] for i in range(n) if assignment[i] == 'B')
postconditions.description: The strength without any flip is the sum of strengths of pieces initially assigned to Bob.

postconditions.expression: all(bob_strength_prefix_flip(k) == sum(strengths[i] for i in range(n) if (i < k and assignment[i] == 'A') or (i >= k and assignment[i] == 'B')) for k in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For any prefix flip of length k, Bob's strength is the sum of pieces that become 'B' after flipping the first k characters.

postconditions.expression: all(bob_strength_suffix_flip(k) == sum(strengths[i] for i in range(n) if (i >= n - k and assignment[i] == 'A') or (i < n - k and assignment[i] == 'B')) for k in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For any suffix flip of length k, Bob's strength is the sum of pieces that become 'B' after flipping the last k characters.
